highlights: **Durable workflows:** An opt-in Labs feature chains agents, code, approvals, schedules, webhooks, and issue or PR events into restart-safe runs. Start runs from the CLI or triggers and follow their progress on web and mobile. Outside agents can also receive thread milestones through MCP polling, streams, or webhooks.

**Server performance and memory:** Idle agent sessions release memory sooner, Claude turns and ACP sessions retain less completed work, and agent terminals keep less output. Thread snapshots stream in bounded chunks; event replay, SQL transaction context handling, checkpoint capture, reconnect branch checks, and child indexing avoid repeated work. These changes do not claim database compaction or measured fleet-wide CPU savings.

**Mobile and everyday responsiveness:** Mobile sidebar selection avoids unrelated shell re-renders, new web threads open drafts without waiting for project configuration, and archived-thread settings cope better with thousands of threads. Android language changes apply immediately, favorites-only is a separate model filter, and gallery actions stay tied to their image.

**Git, projects, and issues:** Multiple Linear accounts are supported. Worktree launches show their branch during creation, branch-race rollback leaves another creation's branch intact, and a grouped project's New thread uses the viewed machine's project. Git commands avoid automatic Git maintenance; storage cleanup retries failed metadata removal and reports failures.

**Remote and desktop reliability:** Remote file opening uses saved SSH routes, origin-checking proxies accept desktop connections, and provider updates survive client disconnects. Hidden or covered desktop windows still support agent screenshots and clicks. Web startup tolerates unavailable WebAssembly, and previews and reading positions survive more resize and navigation cases.

**Providers and background work:** Idle scheduled Codex sessions release resources, Claude picks up externally added session messages, and changing a Claude model uses its updated CLI. Compaction and continuation keep sessions busy, settlement preserves awaited background work, and restarted queued messages stay visible. Antigravity errors and usage reporting become more accurate.

**File previews and attachments:** Large files load fully without freezing previews, PDFs preserve position across pane resizing, and Office/OpenDocument/RTF/EPUB parsing handles more layouts and encodings. Spreadsheet cells, notebook errors, relative Markdown images, merged table cells, hidden text, and emoji formatting receive targeted fixes.
